                     COUNTY COMMISSION MINUTES FOR

                              NOVEMBER 12, 2024

                SUBMITTED FOR APPROVAL DECEMBER 9, 2024

          BE IT REMEMBERED that the Board of Commissioners of Montgomery

County, Tennessee, met in regular session, on Tuesday, November 12, 2024, at

6:00 P.M. Present and presiding, the Hon. Wes Golden, County Mayor (Chairman).

Also present, Lee Harrell, Chief of Staff, Teresa Cottrell, County Clerk, John Fuson,

Sheriff, Tim Harvey, County Attorney, Cassie Wheeler, Director of Accounts and

Budgets, and the following Commissioners:
